name: hs-tracker
description: Press to Handstand Tracker — 離線優先 PWA（sql.js + GitHub Pages + GAS Proxy）

scripts.pretest: node scripts/deps.mjs && npm run gas:build && npm run build && npm run ts:loose
scripts.test: node scripts/secrets-mode.mjs >/dev/null && npm run --silent ts:loose && node --test tests/
scripts.build: node scripts/deps.mjs && vite build && node scripts/web-post.mjs
scripts.hooks: chmod +x .githooks/* && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "hooks: ok (.githooks, 已設可執行位)"
scripts.gas:build: node scripts/deps.mjs && tsc -p gas/tsconfig.json --noEmit && rollup -c rollup.gas.config.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/deps.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.ts:loose: node scripts/deps.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir build/ts --noEmit false --module commonjs --moduleResolution node10
